text:
mira (PM): Quick alignment before tomorrow's exec—need deterministic rules for moving features between MVP and v1. two minutes: propose a small rubric and operational actions.

leo (Eng): +1. tech criteria: (a) >=3 open infra blockers, (b) p95 latency > target on representative workload, (c) requires platform changes >1 sprint.

ana (Design): ana (Design): add UX criteria: regressions that add manual support steps or drop key retention funnels. small copy nits ok if tiny effort.

sam (SRE): sam (SRE): reliability: projected SLO impact >15% of error budget across canary sim => demote or gating behind flag.

jordan (PM): jordan (PM): how about a 2-of-3 pass rule (infra/perf/ux) to stay in MVP? keeps it simple for exec.

leo (Eng): leo (Eng): fine, but allow sponsor-funded exceptions with mitigation + QA plan.

mira (PM): mira (PM): agreed. I'll draft the one-liner for exec: "Only features meeting reliability, performance, and UX guardrails remain in MVP. Others move to v1 unless fast-tracked."

ana (Design): ana (Design): what about low-effort retention wins (onboarding microcopy)?

leo (Eng): leo (Eng): if <=1 dev-day and no infra change, keep in MVP. otherwise apply the rubric.

alex (SE): alex (SE): for pilot customers: if ARR > $50k and legal ok, we can fast-track with scoped rollout + funding.

sam (SRE): sam (SRE): I'll run a quick canary for embed-cache flow today, it's borderline.

release-bot: release-bot: scheduled: staging -> canary at 15:30 UTC.

sam (SRE): sam (SRE): quick canary notes: embed-cache p95 spikes under sustained load. attaching brief in doc.

leo (Eng): leo (Eng): if persists, recommend demote to v1 and schedule optimization spike after launch.

mira (PM): mira (PM): operational items: add a "demotion_reason" column in the cutlist, one owner per candidate, mitigation ETA if keeping. can someone add?

alex (SE): alex (SE): I'll add the column and pre-fill for top 12 by EOD.

jordan (PM): jordan (PM): I'll own the exec slide, run through top 10 tomorrow: keep/demote/fast-track + one-line reason.

leo (Eng): leo (Eng): final: keep an escape clause for marketing needs—sponsor-funded dev and offset scope elsewhere.

mira (PM): mira (PM): perfect. everyone put a one-liner in the sheet by 18:00. short and clear tomorrow. :thumbsup:
